contexts.text: That the cares of the world, etc. render (truths) unfruitful, the Lord teaches in ; and therefore it is said (here) that they should circumcise themselves to Jehovah... that is, purify themselves from such things as... render the truths and goods of faith unfruitful.
As a Church composed of such as are not in natural good... is not a Church, it is said, Why doth it make the land unfruitful? ().
